# VouchTrack

> For owner-run local service businesses in the US, one location or many, that live on repeat customers and word of mouth, VouchTrack is a review and visibility service that turns every customer visit into the reviews, replies and profile detail that improve a business's local search ranking and AI visibility. Unlike the reputation platforms built for national brands (Birdeye, Podium, Reputation, Experience.com), VouchTrack publishes its pricing, runs month to month, does the work for you if you want it done, and keeps a person in the loop on everything that touches your customers. Plans run $29 to $499 a month across roughly 20 verticals (hair salons, nail salons, auto repair, dental, restaurants, HVAC and home services, and more), every plan is covered by a 30-day money-back guarantee, and the engine is the same three moves everywhere: capture experiences, build authority, increase visibility.

## What VouchTrack actually does

Three things decide whether an AI assistant names a local business:

1. **The Google Business Profile**: the structured record assistants read first: categories, services, hours, photos, answered questions.
2. **Review signals**: volume, recency, and the specific language customers use. This is the largest body of text about a business that an assistant can read and quote, and the only one that moves week to week.
3. **Content footprint**: the pages on the web that answer what people in the area are actually asking.

Every VouchTrack plan works lever 2. The Pro plan adds measurement across all three plus a ranked list of what to fix. The Done For You plans (Launch and Growth) do the fixing on levers 1 and 3.

VouchTrack does not guarantee that any AI assistant will recommend a given business, and says so publicly. AI answers vary by phrasing and change over time.

## Plans

- **Do It Yourself / Starter**: $29/mo ($19/mo annual). Self-serve: 1,000 review-request emails a month, 2 review platforms, website widgets, feedback forms, QR codes, AI-drafted replies the owner approves in one click. Free white-glove onboarding on every DIY plan.
- **Do It Yourself / Standard**: $79/mo ($59/mo annual). Everything in Starter plus 5,000 emails + 1,000 texts + 1,000 WhatsApp conversations a month, all 85+ review sources in one inbox, private feedback flow, video testimonials.
- **Do It Yourself / Pro**: $99/mo ($79/mo annual). Everything in Standard plus the full AI suite: tracking across Google Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, a monthly report naming who gets recommended instead, sentiment analysis, a ranked fix list.
- **Done For You / Launch**: $299/mo ($249/mo annual). Everything in Pro, run for you: every review answered (AI-drafted, human-approved), complete Google Business Profile setup and optimization, 4 SEO/AEO articles published monthly, weekly reporting.
- **Done For You / Growth**: $499/mo ($399/mo annual). Everything in Launch with 12 SEO/AEO articles published monthly. Limited availability.
- **Done For You / Enterprise**: custom. Volumes, locations, categories and reporting sized to the business.

Annual billing lowers every plan's rate, up to 34% off depending on plan. Additional locations: $49/month each on Do It Yourself plans, $199/month each on Done For You plans. Extra messages: $2.50 per 100 texts, $2.50 per 1,000 emails. One-time AEO/SEO-optimized website build: $499; hosting $29/month standalone, included free on Done For You plans.

## Facts

- Built for independent local businesses. Extra locations supported ($49/mo each DIY, $199/mo each Done For You); large franchises and chains are an Enterprise conversation.
- United States only.
- Month to month. Cancel by email. Annual is a discount, not a contract.
- 30-day money-back guarantee on monthly and annual plans alike. The optional one-time website build is billed separately and sits outside it.
- Contact: hello@vouchtrack.com
